name: Infisical
description: Open-source secrets management platform for securely storing, syncing, and managing application secrets, configs, and certificates across teams and infrastructure.

env.label: Encryption Key
env.description: Key used to encrypt and decrypt secrets at rest. Must be a 16-byte hex string (32 hex chars). If the generated value is not valid hex, generate one with: openssl rand -hex 16. Losing this key makes stored secrets unrecoverable.

env.label: Auth Secret
env.description: Secret used to sign JWT auth tokens. Should be a 32-byte base64 string. If the generated value is unsuitable, generate one with: openssl rand -base64 32.

env.label: PostgreSQL Password
env.description: Password for the internal PostgreSQL database. The DB connection string is built from this automatically.

env.label: Site URL
env.description: External URL users access Infisical at, including protocol (e.g. https://secrets.example.com).
